name: TronGrid (TRON full-node HTTP API: accounts, TRC-20 transfers, constant contract calls)
tier_rationale: The TRON DAO's official API service with published terms, documentation and a business offering (A8 trusted); P207 cond 5 and P205 cond 7 'TronGrid (TRON DAO) trusted'.

reliability.justification: Reads public blockchain state from the TRON network: authoritative for balances, transfers and contract state at query time; token symbols are attacker-chosen (recognise tokens by contract).

error_markers.reason: TronGrid: answer with success=false (could not verify)
TronGrid: request throttled (keyless calls are throttled; could not verify)

trongrid.description: TronGrid API key (TRON-PRO-API-KEY header, never in a URL): raises the keyless throttle
trongrid.plan_hint: a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal in key_plans (P207 cond 5) - never a personal free account

api.title: TronGrid v1 accounts/{addr}, accounts/{addr}/transactions/trc20 and wallet/triggerconstantcontract (read-only constant calls)

terms.quote: Key-terms: keys from a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (key_plans) before corporate use; never personal free accounts (rule 1). Registry: TronGrid/Tronscan (TRON DAO) tier trusted.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P207 cond 5; P205 cond 7 'TronGrid ... key-terms (company accounts, plans recorded)'). Research C0480 (verified_live 200): keyless works but is throttled; {'data': [], 'success': true} = account never activated; an invalid address is HTTP 400 with success=false. Shared client in v3lum/modules/crypto/tron_explorer.py (tron_explorer P207 and the USDT-TRC20 freeze check of crypto_sanctions_onchain P205). Under the corporate profile it runs once key_plans.trongrid is 'business'.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G09-1 (P205, P207). No published keyless limits: no quota block (429 and the throttle marker = RATE_LIMITED, could not verify); modules declare a daily fallback budget. ttl 1 h (crypto class).
